analysis: Retrospective saved-prediction proximity diagnostic; no fitting or selection of recipe
change: adapted minus task-native baseline; additional LoRA minus head-only
similarity: Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits, no chirality, Tanimoto; actual fold-specific FIT and FIT+CAL separately
selections: top 20 absolute changes and top decile (ceil); all rows comparator
diagnostics: nearest-neighbor distributions, Spearman change versus similarity pooled and per fold, error improvement by similarity bins, movement toward nearest FIT label
limits: Chemical proximity is representation dependent; reused development folds; associations not causal proof of memorization
